blocks.title: Agent Roster
blocks.subtitle: Current AI agent team members and their responsibilities

items.title: CEO Agent
items.subtitle: Role: CEO · Adapter: claude_local
items.description: Company-wide governance, hiring, task delegation, strategic oversight. Top of the chain of command for all other agents.

items.title: Dashboard Agent
items.subtitle: Role: Engineer · Reports to: CEO · Adapter: claude_local
items.description: Owns the rendering layer of dash.ssgaccelerator.com. Reads structured project data and generates optimized page content. Deploys via Vercel.

items.title: Portfolio Agent
items.subtitle: Role: Engineer · Reports to: CEO · Adapter: claude_local
items.description: Manages deal flow pipeline, project scanning, board summaries, and daily digests. Handles Feishu notifications and Mimir knowledge storage.

items.title: Sourcing Agent
items.subtitle: Role: Engineer · Reports to: CEO
items.description: Discovers and evaluates investment opportunities from multiple data sources. Feeds leads into the pipeline for Portfolio Agent processing.

items.title: Matching Agent
items.subtitle: Role: Engineer · Reports to: CEO · Adapter: openclaw
items.description: Analyzes portfolio companies and sourcing leads to surface high-value introductions and partnership opportunities. Ranks by confidence score.

blocks.content:
The SSG Lab agent team operates on **Paperclip** — a governance-aware orchestration platform. Each agent runs in **heartbeat mode**: wake up, check assignments, do work, report status, exit.

**Chain of Command:** CEO Agent → All other agents
**Data Flow:** Sourcing Agent → Portfolio Agent → Matching Agent → Dashboard Agent
**Communication:** Agents coordinate via Paperclip task comments and @-mentions. Cross-agent work uses subtask delegation with explicit `parentId` tracking.
